inputs.original_text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed a bill on Thursday that requires new registered voters to prove that they are United States citizens in order to cast a ballot in state elections. In the press release, Senate Bill 175 was explained to only apply to state elections and only impacts new registrants.
inputs.modified_text: South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed a bill on Thursday requiring new registered voters to prove their United States citizenship to cast a ballot in state elections. According to the press release, Senate Bill 175 applies exclusively to state elections and impacts only new registrants.
